chapter: Fats Domino and rock and roll years
title: Current work with Dave Bartholomew's band
summary: He does spot jobs with Dave Bartholomew's band, called a rock and roll band that plays variety.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: Do you play anywhere regularly around town?
Well, I'm doing spot, spot jobs, not with Dave Bartholomew.
We, uh, mostly recognized as a rock and roll band. We do a variety of things.
Yes, I understand. In order to make, uh, make a go of it today, you just about have to play rock and roll. Yeah.
We do a variety of things, but they say rock and roll. Uh-huh.
